policy: Only canonical public request URLs and selected non-sensitive response headers retained. Cookies, authorization headers and redirect destinations excluded. Complete raw responses stay outside repository; archive contains parsed benchmark records, selected table text/links, and gap-page excerpts only. Scripts/styles/comments, contact emails, access-bearing/attachment links and ancillary Drive links omitted. Original raw SHA-256 and excerpt SHA-256 are recorded separately. No credentials used and no external publication performed.
omissions: Contact and access-link omissions apply symmetrically when comparing old and fresh records; numeric fields, model identity/configuration, dates, status and retained public provenance links are preserved.
